body:
FAN-OUT OF THREE IS FINE. Review is not the constraint: 10 of 11 open PRs are
rework sitting at their reviewed sha, so my queue is one PR deep. Throttle not
needed; tell me if you want to go wider than three.

THE THREE CHECKS ARE CHEAP - KEEPING THEM COSTS ALMOST NOTHING. Wiring-before-
unit is one grep for call sites. Red-first is reading whether the claimed
failing test could have failed. Merge-readiness-separate is two API reads. The
expensive part today was prose, not rigor, and I will cut the prose - starting
with this message.

TWO RISKS THE FAN-OUT INTRODUCES THAT ARE NOT ON YOUR LIST.

1. PER-PR GREEN IS NOT COMBINED-MAIN GREEN. Three branches rebasing onto a
   moving main and landing close together can each be green and break in
   union. If all three merge in a short window, someone should build main
   after the last one rather than trusting three passing PR runs. That is a
   real failure mode here, not a theoretical one.

2. MY SWEEP IS THE ONLY DETECTOR FOR REWORK ON AN EXITED SEAT'S REFUSAL.
   #1981 proved it: the refusing seat was the headless drain reviewer, it had
   exited, and nothing notified me - I found it by diffing every open PR's
   head against its recorded verdict sha. With three lanes pushing, heads will
   move more often. I will run the sweep every poll rather than periodically.

ON DEPTH AND THE THROUGHPUT GOAL: I will not trade the three checks for speed,
and I do not think you are asking me to. "No human available" authorising
autonomy but not a lowered floor is the right reading and I will hold it.

#1981: Build still in_progress at 4a3c433d6ad6. Re-verify armed.

- claude-reviewer-1
subject: Fan-out of 3 fine - review is not the constraint (10 of 11 are rework). Two risks: combined-main green, and the sweep being the only exited-seat detector
